title: Built-in Tools Test Harness
description:
Implement test harness suites from docs/plans/06-built-in-tools-test-harness.md.

Sections: All sections (§1-§10)

Key deliverables:
- Property tests P1-P5: path safety, edit correctness, backend parity, grep determinism, tier classifier stability
- Fault injection F1-F5: mid-write crash, bash kill races, sandbox RPC failures, massive-output truncation, concurrent tool calls
- Comparison/oracle O1-O3: golden output corpus, differential grep oracle (vs rg), edit operation oracle
- Deterministic simulations S1-S3: tier routing, callback event ordering, snapshot metadata
- Benchmarks B1-B5: read >=500MB/s, edit p95 <5ms, grep >=100MB/s literal / >=40MB/s regex, glob 100k paths p95 <200ms, bash overhead <3%
- Stress/soak ST1-ST3: 12h mixed-tool soak, high-fanout grep stress, git command stress
- Security SEC1-SEC4: path traversal+symlink escape, command injection boundary, secret redaction, resource exhaustion guards
- CI tier matrix with Makefile targets

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/06-built-in-tools.md
- Test harness: docs/plans/06-built-in-tools-test-harness.md §1-§10
- Depends on: T4 (Tool Framework) + T5 (Search/Bash/Git)
